info.name: SocialMedia
info.description:
# SocialMedia API Collection

Hand-curated Postman Collection v2.1 for local Gateway demos and manual verification.

## Import
1. Import this collection and `Local.postman_environment.json`
2. Select environment **Local**
3. Confirm `gateway` = `http://localhost:8080`

## Required variables
`gateway`, `aliceEmail`, `aliceUsername`, `alicePassword`, `bobEmail`, `bobUsername`, `bobPassword`, plus capture slots (`aliceId`, `bobId`, `aliceJwt`, `bobJwt`, post IDs, cursors).

## First-time vs re-run
- **First time**: run `00 Happy Path` top-to-bottom (includes register).
- **Re-run (login-first)**: skip or ignore register conflicts; run Login Alice/Bob to refresh JWTs; continue social steps.

## Scripts policy
Scripts are **capture-only** (`pm.environment.set`). No `pm.test` / pass-fail assertions. Expected outcomes are in each request description — verify responses manually.

## Alice & Bob
Stable demo pair for follow/timeline/notifications. Dedicated rate-limit and fan-out identities live in optional folders.
